author: CAPTANIRONFIST
body:
IGN:CAPTANIRONRIST
Reason for ban: DDos threats
Guilty: I am :(
Why you should be unbanned: First is a bit of a reason to how I act the way I did yesterday, when I get mad at video games in particular change to a different person, I'm trying to better myself in that sense, and after all this time raging I guess I got what I deserved, I would like to be unbanned so that I can show that I can improve myself, I msged zero after I was rude to him explaining myself and how I was sorry, but yet again I got angry at some fly harckers and I got angry again...I hope that you will unban me, I do not mind waiting to be unbanned if that is what is reqired before my unban, if you unban me I promise never to act like a idiot ingame and ill concentrate on keeping a cool head, thank you for reading my appeal,

Sincerely, IronFist
